description: This file defines a class for transforming boolean attributes into CSS styles within the HTMLPurifier library. It converts specific boolean attributes into inline CSS declarations by removing the attribute and prepending CSS styles.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_BoolToCSS
classes.description: A class that converts boolean HTML attributes into CSS styles for HTML purification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute name and CSS declaration to be applied.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms attributes by removing a specific boolean attribute and adding associated CSS styles.
